Our Story

Built on Trust,
Driven by Expertise

Since 2009, Limra Property Solution has been your dedicated partner in navigating the real estate world. Over the years, we have proudly collaborated with India's most esteemed developers — including Godrej, Eldeco, Jaypee, and many others — building a strong foundation of trust, credibility, and deep market expertise in the property landscape.

We believe that a great property experience goes far beyond the transaction. At Limra, we offer a truly end-to-end journey — from the earliest stages of your property search to comprehensive support long after the sale is complete. We are here to solve every challenge that arises along the way. Our team meticulously handles all legal documentation and streamlines the entire process, making your property journey as smooth and stress-free as possible.

Looking ahead, we are excited to broaden our horizons. We are actively working towards expanding into interior design, construction design, and exterior design — with the vision of offering a complete suite of property solutions under one roof. Our ultimate goal has always been the same: to ensure you have the finest property experience possible, from start to finish.

Your journey to a perfect property — simplified, supported, and successful — starts with us.

Our Authority Partners

Approved by Leading Authorities

All our properties are verified and approved by the most trusted development authorities in the region — giving you complete peace of mind.

Noida Development Authority
NDA governs planned development and property approvals across Noida and Greater Noida sectors.
Yamuna Expressway Industrial Development Authority
YEIDA oversees development along the Yamuna Expressway corridor — one of the fastest-growing investment zones in India.
Uttar Pradesh State Industrial Development Authority
UPSIDA promotes industrial and commercial development across Uttar Pradesh with approved land parcels and infrastructure.
